notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.6.7
notes.notes:
Greetings Managers,

It's with great pleasure that we can now release the [b]1.0.6.7 update[/b] recenrly tested on our Open Beta servers. The content can look small at first but it is resolving two major issues that were blocking the progression of the community.

You can read the update's content through the Patch Notes below.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]3D Course[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in which the majority of riders were piling up in the same place and were no longer moving forward (that could lead to a game crash)[/list][h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolving a game crash issue[/list]
Thank you for your continuous source feedback, our team keeps working on improving the quality of the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.6.3
notes.notes:
Following yesterday's update of Pro Cycling Manager 2022 we have deployed an follow-up update that resolved some issues reported during the Open Beta.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Simulations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug where sprinters’ teammates were not efficient during mass sprints. It was difficult to get optimal results with a sprinter when you used a good teammate.[/list][h2]Career[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a crash that could happen in scouting’s page.[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.6.2
notes.notes:
Greetings Managers,

It's with great pleasure that we can now release the [b]1.0.6.2 update[/b] (including the content of the 1.0.5.1 update) which was available on the Open Beta build to the public servers of Pro Cycling Manager 2022.

Our team is currently preparing an additional patch to fix a bug in the performance of sprinters in quick simulation as well as a crash on the scouting map.

You can read the update's content through the Patch Notes below.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug where variant choice of a race was not possible in multiplayer custom tournaments.[/list][h2]Career[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add scout details hint box
[*] Fix a rare crash in career between 24 and 25 October with wrong U23 link in a mod.
[*] Fix UI Planner does not take U23 races into account when registering the riders.
[*] Add feedback in the news when you have no more budget or no more slots to sign a rider.
[*] Fix a rare crash in career when there were not enough scouts in a mod.
[*] Fix a bug where the staff sent a mail with the wrong style for “evolution of the training style”.
[*] Fix a bug where a some young riders could still appear in dossiers but there were not supposed to be signed for next year.
[*] Fix a minor bug in the race pop-up regarding the palmares.
[*] New button "Add to shortlist" in the rider's page.
[*] Add Efficiency column on trainer tab (Staff page).
[*] Add Filters on Transferts page : Evaluation and Potential.[/list][h2]3D Races[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update race director’s Skoda car
[*] Fix a rare crash with sprint train.
[*] Fix classifications problems with 3km rule (sometimes classification could be messy).
[*] Fix a bug where it was not possible to use the RELAY button during the race.
[*] Fix a weird animation in time-trial races.[/list][h2]Database[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update several team jerseys (Lotto-Soudal, Alpecin-Deceuninck, Bora-Hansgrohe, Trek-Segafredo)
[*] Update Logo “Skoda” => "Skoda We Love Cycling"[/list][h2]Modding[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvement: display log path when errors are detected in a modded database[/list]
Thank you for your continuous source feedback, our team keeps working on improving the quality of the game!

notes.title: Open Beta Update - Version 1.0.6.2
notes.notes:
We have released a new patch for the Open Beta of Pro Cycling Manager 2022. It will fix a couple of issues reported from last week Open Beta but most notably updates the database following the end of the Tour de France 2022.  You can read the update's content through the Patch Notes below.

[h1]How to join the Open Beta[/h1]
To join the Open Beta: 
[list]
[*] Open Steam > Library 
[*] Right-click on Pro Cycling Manager 2022 > Properties 
[*] Select Beta and enter the following code: GauduPCM2022
[*] Verify the code and download the Open Beta branch. [/list]To leave your feedback from your time on the Open Beta you can either leave it on the Steam Discussions (with the appropriate [OPEN BETA] tag in the title so we know its relevant to this version of the game) or on our Official Discord in one of the appropriate channels.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug where variant choice of a race was not possible in multiplayer custom tournaments.[/list][h2]Career[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add scout details hint box
[*] Fix a rare crash in career between 24 and 25 October with wrong U23 link in a mod.
[*] Fix UI Planner does not take U23 races into account when registering the riders.
[*] Add feedback in the news when you have no more budget or no more slots to sign a rider.[/list][h2]3D Races[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update race director’s Skoda car[/list][h2]Database[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update several team jerseys (Lotto-Soudal, Alpecin-Quickstep, Bora-Hansgrohe, Trek-Segafredo)
[*] Update Logo “Skoda” => "Skoda We Love Cycling"[/list][h2]Modding[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvement: display log path when errors are detected in a modded database[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.4.3
notes.notes:
Greetings Managers,

It's with great pleasure that we can now release the 1.0.4.3 update which was available on the Open Beta build to the public servers of Pro Cycling Manager 2022.

You can read the update's content through the Patch Notes below.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Crash Fix: Auto-Fix Corrupted saves which keep crashing when playing with a non-updated mod (aka August/September crash).
[*] Fix Race: Improve sprinters' energy management in stages races. During flat stages they often waste their energy compared to other riders.
[*] Fix Race: "When zooming on a rider with the F5 camera, it was not properly centered on the rider"
[*] Fix Race: During cobble classics, it was possible to see major teams working both in the front group and in the chase group.
[*] Bug Fix: The Training tab In The Rider Page was not accessible for our riders from the U23 team.
[*] Bug Fix: In the Custom Team UI only 5 Eval Dots were displayed instead of 6.
[*] Bug Fix: Individual Rankings in Archives/Season stats did not update properly.
[*] Crash Fix: Fix a possible crash in multiplayer when hovering a race.
[*] Rollback: In rare cases, the classification could be mess-up after a fall in the last 3 km. In this version we removed the feature. A real fix will comes later after further tests.
[*] Bug Fix: Fix a bug with dynamic potential (only limits were updated, not the raw potential)
[*] Bug DB: Add Missing Portuguese texts[/list]

Thank you for your continuous source feedback, our team keeps working on improving the quality of the game!

notes.title: Open Beta Update - Version 1.0.4.3
